title: Allow nearby supplies; store what needs protection
applies_when: Materials exist but construction or production cannot use them.
approach: Use Unforbid All to release explored supplies in one operation; it leaves insect jelly unchanged. Other items near threats are still allowed, so use selected-item Allow when a narrower release is needed.
Loose allowed materials can supply work directly. Hauling everything into a stockpile is not a prerequisite for placing or supplying a blueprint.
Put protected storage near camp. Use small, higher-priority filtered stockpiles by workbenches for frequently used inputs; keep dumping storage for chunks and waste separate.
verify: Observed IDs and flags, ingredient filters, storage priority, free space and actual deliveries.
reconsider: Stock is across a dangerous route, or repeated hauling moves the same items between stores.
